verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Notion serves an llms.txt at developers.notion.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), which indexes Markdown versions of its docs, and many cited guide and reference pages are served as .md files. A machine-readable openapi.json and dedicated MCP guides add agent-oriented documentation an agent can be pointed at. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other expanded agent docs bundle.
